Apple to Launch Foldable iPhone Ultra with Potential Larger Battery

Apple is reportedly planning to launch its first foldable smartphone in September. The device's design and battery life are expected to be different from traditional foldable phones. Details about the phone's screen, price, and other features have leaked online.
